steps.input:
n=19
grid=[[0]*n for _ in range(n)]
objs=[(3,6,8),(4,13,4),(12,14,1),(14,3,2)]
for r,c,v in objs:
    grid[r][c]=v
    for dr,dc in ((-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1)):
        grid[r+dr][c+dc]=3
out=[]
for r in range(n):
    row=[]
    for c in range(n):
        if grid[r][c]: v=grid[r][c]
        else:
            vert=next((v for rr,cc,v in objs if c==cc),None)
            horiz=next((v for rr,cc,v in objs if r==rr),None)
            v=vert if vert is not None else (horiz if horiz is not None else 0)
        row.append(v)
    out.append(row)
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in out))
